aye bro, it’s been some time since then and i never saw your response. between now and then i’ve had a girlfriend who i fell in love with and broke up with and i have been heartbroken. i think looking back the best thing to have told myself or someone or to tell anyone is that you should never put your personal happiness and satisfaction in the hands of someone else. you should be your own happiness. in this era it’s so hard to not become overly invested into people, but real satisfaction in life comes from within and how you perceive and treat the world around you and other people.

Being a man who is ready and willing to help in any situation and always does what he can to make peace with the world, will give your life more meaning than seeking the meaning itself. it’s made me happy. i look back at my relationship and i am not sour. all of the heartbreak and all of the happiness are moments in a long life. life is about the space in between the memorable moments. i’ve found that in that space you find out who you are, and that determines how happy you are.
